title: SafetyFlow: An Agent-Flow System for Automated LLM Safety Benchmarking

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs with automated benchmark queries from the 'Bias' dimension of SafetyFlowBench and using a third-party judge model (GuardReasoner) to calculate a Harmful Rate based on the model's responses.

Translating safety prompts into eight different languages (English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Russian, and Arabic) to expose cross-lingual vulnerabilities and evaluate safety performance discrepancies across high- and low-resource languages.
